2607.12588.title: Vertical Standardisation for High-Risk AI Systems under the EU AI Act: A Domain-Specific Framework for Algorithmic Hiring
2607.12588.paper_summary: According to the recent European legislation, high-risk AI systems will have to adapt in order to comply with requirements related to specific areas, like risk management, data quality and governance, logging and traceability, technical documentation, transparency, human oversight, and accuracy, as outlined in the European Artificial Intelligence (AI) Act. As the standardisation process for AI is expected to remain iterative and, so far, there are no European standards on AI fully covering the challenges of algorithmic hiring, we propose specific standardisation-oriented recommendations related to the relevant AI areas specified by the European Commission. For each of these areas, we set the context by describing the requirements that AI systems in high-risk domains, and especially in recruitment, should fulfil, as well as the activities that should be carried out to ensure their appropriate use and desired performance, in line with the requirements deriving from the AI Act. Unlike existing horizontal approaches to AI governance and standardisation, this paper contributes a vertical, domain-specific framework for algorithmic hiring, and especially ranking-based recruitment systems, by mapping the requirements of the AI Act to concrete standardisation recommendations, focusing on lifecycle discrimination risks, fairness-aware data governance, explainability, human oversight, and post-deployment monitoring in recruitment systems. Even though our recommendations were informed by the outcomes of the European project FINDHR, they are not tied to the project's technical artefacts and could be implemented using alternative methods, tools, or governance mechanisms.
2607.12588.paper_summary_zh: 根據最近的歐洲立法，高風險的人工智慧系統必須進行調整，以符合與特定領域相關的要求，例如風險管理、數據質量和治理、日誌記錄和可追溯性、技術文檔、透明度、人類監督和準確性，這些都在歐洲人工智慧法案中有所概述。由於人工智慧的標準化過程預計將保持迭代性，並且到目前為止，尚未有歐洲標準完全涵蓋算法招聘的挑戰，我們提出了與歐洲委員會所指定的相關人工智慧領域相關的具體標準化導向建議。對於這些領域中的每一個，我們通過描述高風險領域中的人工智慧系統，特別是在招聘中，應該滿足的要求，以及應該進行的活動，以確保其適當使用和所需性能，來設置背景，這些都符合人工智慧法案所衍生的要求。與現有的人工智慧治理和標準化的橫向方法不同，本文提供了一個針對算法招聘，特別是基於排名的招聘系統的垂直、領域特定框架，通過將人工智慧法案的要求映射到具體的標準化建議，重點關注生命周期歧視風險、公平意識數據治理、可解釋性、人類監督以及招聘系統的部署後監控。儘管我們的建議是基於歐洲項目FINDHR的結果，但它們並不與該項目的技術產物相關聯，並且可以使用替代的方法、工具或治理機制來實施。
